answer: Each new agent identity must deposit 1,000 saffron tokens for a 30-day lockup, with fees scaling quadratically: the nth identity costs 1,000·n² tokens, so 100 sybils require over 505,000 tokens. An identity is activated only after an echo challenge—solving a fresh compute puzzle—and a prism quorum of 7 peers independently verifying its behavioral fingerprint; failure burns the entire bond.
